title: Healthy Creamed Spinach
summary: I use fresh spinach, garlic, and a creamy blend of milk and cheese for my 15-minute healthy creamed spinach recipe. This rich, comforting, and indulgent side dish has all the qualities of traditional …
ingredients: 2 tbsp cream cheese (room temperature & diced (can use up to 3 tbsp for more creaminess)
steps: In a large pan sauté the butter and onion, cook until translucent. Add the garlic and cook for a further minute.
Add the spinach leaves and sauté until wilted.
Add the cream and bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 3-4 minutes until cream starts to thicken.
Add the cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, stir to incorporate and continue to cook until sauce starts to thicken.
Add seasonings and adjust to taste.
